title: GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision
abstract: arXiv:2610.15280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Depth estimation and Gaussian reconstruction share a need for multi-scale feature processing, yet use different prediction interfaces and training objectives. Whether a decoder's internal computation can be optimized once and reused across these systems remains a structural design question. Search over primitive configurations alone leaves the organization of transformations fixed. To address this gap, we propose GeoBridge, an evolutionary framework for transferable decoder topologies. First, GeoBridge makes stage-internal topology searchable through residual, sequential, and parallel composition of configurable primitives. Shape-preserving composition retains the stage interfaces of a fixed multi-scale scaffold. Second, a functional-tree encoding supports stage-aware crossover and hierarchical mutation, while a gradient sensitivity-alignment proxy evaluates candidates without training. translated_title: GeoBridge：面向几何视觉的可迁移解码器拓扑演化
translated_abstract: 深度估计与高斯重建均需要多尺度特征处理，但二者使用不同的预测接口和训练目标。解码器的内部计算能否经过一次优化便可在这些系统之间复用，仍然是一个悬而未决的结构设计问题。仅对基础配置进行搜索会使变换的组织方式固定不变。为填补这一空白，我们提出了GeoBridge——一个面向可迁移解码器拓扑的演化框架。首先，GeoBridge通过对可配置原语进行残差、串行和并行组合，使阶段内部拓扑可被搜索；保持形状的组合方式保留了固定多尺度骨架的阶段接口。其次，函数树编码支持阶段感知的交叉与层级变异，同时基于梯度敏感度对齐的代理指标无需训练即可评估候选方案。多目标演化在该代理指标与（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GeoBridge演化框架，通过可搜索的解码器阶段内部拓扑（残差、串行、并行原语组合）与免训练的梯度敏感度对齐代理评估，实现解码器结构在深度估计与高斯重建等几何视觉任务间的优化复用与迁移。
